text:
zoe: New hire hit onboarding pain — `brew install` -> `redwoodctl init` -> quickstart fails during `redwoodctl login --headless`.

ben: what symptom?

zoe: CLI prints `waiting for callback at http://127.0.0.1:12345` but never receives it. Browser shows callback delivered. They were on WSL2 + Docker.

kai: WSL network / localhost semantics bite again. redwoodctl binds only to 127.0.0.1 by default. In container setups you often need `--local-callback-host=0.0.0.0`. We added that flag but quickstart docs are silent.

zoe: Also their existing `~/.redwood/profiles/default` had token from a previous account so `init` refused to create `quickstart` profile and silently reused `default`. End result: mismatch between sample app and CLI profile. New hires confused.

ben: Fixes proposed: 1) change postinstall message to `redwoodctl init --profile quickstart` 2) make `init` interactive when it would reuse an existing profile and show a one-line summary of created files 3) doctor command: detect Docker/WSL and hint `--local-callback-host` or `--device-code` for CI.

kai: also: reduce retry spam. When waiting for the headless callback, show a spinner and after 10s print one clear hint (docker/wsld/bind issues or TLS x509). Current noisy retries confuse folks.

zoe: another TLS case: corp TLS inspection caused `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority`. The user had `SSL_CERT_FILE` set but redwoodctl ignored it.

ben: short-term: doctor should check common env vars like `SSL_CERT_FILE` and `REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE` and warn that the CLI does not read them. Mid-term: add `--trust-local-ca /path/to/ca.pem` for headless flows (session-scoped, never persisted).

kai: agree. Also add explicit error mapping: on x509 unknown authority, print: "If you're on a corporate network with SSL inspection, either add your CA to system trust or run `redwoodctl login --trust-local-ca /path/to/ca.pem` (dev-only) or use `--device-code`. See docs link."

ci-bot: lint: branch `devex/onboard-wsl-profile-fixes` passes docs lint

zoe: I'll file tickets and a small PR to change postinstall text + doctor hints + spinner/backoff. Tagging devex and eng-platform.

ben: thanks! :thumbsup:
